analysis: EXPLORATORY, not pre-registered; re-creation of leakage_results/pathway_vs_fingerprint.json (commit f6676f9), whose script was never committed; this record supersedes it. The fold sensitivity is new and exploratory.

settings.features: [A, line one-hot, A x line]; A = dose-scaled 1,024-bit fingerprint (Squidiff Drug_dose_encoder), or a plain one-hot of pathway_level_2, or a plain one-hot of target (labels not scaled by dose)
settings.ridge: sklearn Ridge, intercept, unscaled features, double precision
settings.best_penalty: largest condition median per split and model, chosen on the scored conditions (as the old record)
settings.folds: five folds grouped by compound; the assignment of the paper, written out in PAPER_FOLDS and stored under 'folds'; it is what sklearn GroupKFold returns when numpy orders ties without AVX-512 code
settings.score: DPC-50: Pearson of predicted and measured change over the 50 genes with the largest |measured change| (stable sort), per condition; condition median (mean also stored); no variance counts as 0

old_record.note: the old run used single precision; its fingerprint values at penalties below 1 depend on rounding and are not repeatable to better than about 1e-3 on another processor

fold_sensitivity.rule: compounds in random order (numpy RandomState(seed).permutation), largest first (stable), each to the fold that is lightest so far; five folds
